main_text.p: Etenim una cum Episcopo, quiererat primus Præsidens ( ac propterea apud eundem Tertullianum alio in loco distinctionis ergo appellatus, summus Sacerdos ) [ dandi quidem baptismi habet jus summus Sacerdos, qui est Episcopus : dehinc Presbyteri & Diaconi. Id. de Bapt. cap. 17.] cæteri Verbi & sacramentorum dispensatores jungebantur in communi Ecclesiæ regimine : ac propterea ubi in rebus judicii Ecclesiastici Cornelius Episcopus Romanus solitâ utitur formulâ [ omni actu ad me perlato placuit contrahi presbyterium. Cornel. apud Cypr. epist. 46.] congregandi una presbyterium, ex quibus id constiterit, plane declarat Cyprianus, quando eum rogat litteras suas legere [ Cyprian. epist. 55. ad Cornel. ] florentissimo illic clero, secum præsidenti: Cleri præsentiâ habitâ adeo necessariâ in rebus episcopalis audientiæ, ut in quarto Carthaginensi Concilio conclusum sit: [ Concil. Carthag. iv. cap. 23.] ut Episcopus nullius causam audiat absque præsentiâ Clericorum suorum, alioquin irrita

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page is present in the upper and middle parts of the scan; the bracketed marginal references are printed inline and transcribed where they stand. Some words are faint or blurred (e.g. "quiererat", "ac propterea"); the reading "quiererat" for "quiverat" is doubtful and the printed text is copied as it appears.
